Description: Victoria Maseko and Annie Beaumont, both emotionally agitated, discuss their connection to a corpse. Victoria insists they are linked to the dead from the past and tries to prove their relationship to Annie.
Location: Victoria Maseko's room（Victoria's room）
Key Information:
  - Victoria Maseko recalls her relationship with her husband, Damian Maseko, and firmly believes they share an inseparable bond.
  - Annie Beaumont does not recall that Damian Maseko is Victoria’s husband, and is confused and worried by Victoria’s emotional state.
  - Victoria hands Annie Beaumont a note listing the names of all living people, telling Annie to recall it constantly and forget no one.
  - Victoria repeatedly begs Annie to remember what happened in the past, but Annie cannot recall anything.
  - After thunder, Annie realizes another corpse has appeared in the same location and leaves the room in shock.
  - After Annie leaves, Victoria begins writing down the names of all living people as her only anchor for memory.
  - After No. 7 (Victoria Maseko) dies, No. 2 (Annie Beaumont) also forgets Victoria Maseko, causing confusion about facts and identities.
Characters:
  [Victoria Maseko（Victoria Maseko）] Person No. 7, an emotionally agitated woman who believes she has a connection to the dead.
    · Tries to convince Annie Beaumont to remember the past and the connection to the dead.
    · Insists what happened after last night’s dinner is directly tied to the appearance of the corpse.
    · Hands Annie a paper, saying it is their only clue.
    · Recalls her husband Damian Maseko, but Annie cannot remember him, creating confusion.
    · After Victoria dies, Annie forgets everything about her.
  [Annie Beaumont（Annie Beaumont）] Person No. 2, tries to stay calm and understand Victoria’s behavior.
    · Tries to calm Victoria and denies any connection to the dead or other people.
    · Worries about Victoria’s mood swings and begins to suspect Victoria may be hallucinating.
    · Asks whether Victoria has seen anyone else, trying to gather more information.
    · Cannot recall that Damian Maseko is Victoria’s husband, becoming confused.
    · After Victoria dies, also forgets her, leaving Annie’s memory incomplete.
